name: octaweave_whoami
description: Identify the API key: returns {user, actor:{type,label,workspace_id}, scopes, is_admin}. CALL THIS FIRST in any Octaweave session — a key is pinned to exactly one workspace and actor.workspace_id is the only reliable way to learn which. Every other tool needs it as `workspace`. It is also the cheapest proof the key works.
